audience: SEO teams and agencies that track keyword rankings and competitors in Keyword.com

useCases.title: Review how rankings moved
useCases.text: List your projects and read the counts of keywords that moved up, down or are new over a timeframe.

useCases.title: Read the rank history of keywords
useCases.text: List the keywords of a project with their current and best rank. Read the daily ranking positions of the keywords over a number of days.

useCases.title: See who ranks for a keyword
useCases.text: Read the top 100 competing URLs for one keyword over a date range, with their rank and result type.

useCases.title: Check share of voice and top pages
useCases.text: Read share of voice over a date range or a number of days. Read the top-performing pages of a project by their keyword positions.

useCases.title: Add keywords to a project
useCases.text: Check the tracked regions of a project, then add keywords for rank tracking. A keyword the project already tracks gets its settings updated, not duplicated.
